name: HyprRipple — Water Click Ripples
author: jgarza
description: Water click ripples on your Omarchy desktop, drawn by Hyprland. Choose a full water splash or the compact 250 ms Water (Short) preset, plus Material ink and other effects. After adding, run ./install in the plugin folder to build the native plugin. Settings: Omarchy menu > Style > HyprRipple.
